_meta.description: Consolidated taxonomy delta synthesized from 18 per-pack discovery reports (148 proposed tags + 51 proposed compound tags). Implement against tags/src/tags/<folder>/<file>.ts following the heal/main.ts + stats-mod/boost-in-test.ts conventions. Enum string VALUES are kebab-case. 'usedByDwl' marks items motivated by at least one dwl (pack code 02xxx) card, for the dwl pilot subset.

newFiles.rationale: Sets/overrides the BASE value of a skill to a fixed number (e.g. 'base combat skill of 6', 'set base value of each skill to 5'). Distinct from additive boosts (boost-in-test/passive) and from BuffStatsReplace (stat-for-stat swap). 'value' carries the fixed base; the skill it applies to is usually all-skills or context-dependent, so kept as a single tag rather than per-skill variants. Consolidates dwl base-stat override (Duke, Strange Solution, Red-Gloved Man), rt Trial by Fire, tcu Trial by Fire, tic Eye of the Djinn.

ADDS a second stat's value on top of the test's normal skill value for one action ('Add your [agility] to your skill value for this attack'). Distinct from BuffStatsReplace (swap) and boost (flat +N). 'from' = donor stat; 'action' optional = which action it applies to. The single biggest cross-pack gap, flagged in source as '// stat_add_*_for_* - Need tag type'.

Per-action, per-test stat substitution ('This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]'). Distinct from BuffStatsReplace, which the digest documents as a PASSIVE card-wide from->to replacement (Mr. Rook style). These are action-scoped one-shot overrides on events/weapons. 'use'/'instead' = the two stats; 'action' = which action's test. Consolidates win Pilfer/Backstab/Sharpshooter, tfa Mists/Ornate Bow/Blood Eclipse/Handcuffs, tde Empower Self/Mind's Eye. NOTE: implementer may instead choose to add an optional 'action?' arg to BuffStatsReplace; kept separate here because the per-test scope is the searchable distinction.

THE defining gap of the bless/curse cycle. Existing chaos tags only model reacting to REVEALED tokens; nothing expresses ADDING / REMOVING-RETURNING / REPLACING bless/curse tokens in the bag. 'value' = count (-1 for X/variable). Replace variant carries from/to. The old regex wrongly collapsed 'add bless' into 'chaos_reveal_token_bless'. Consolidates fhv ChaosBagAdd/Remove Bless/Curse, tic ChaosBagAdd/Remove/Replace, par ChaosBlessCurseAdd/Remove.

Exile (a keyword introduced in dwl: removes the card from your deck/collection on use, with XP-repurchase implications). A deliberate deckbuilding/campaign mechanic distinct from discard-from-play (recoverable) and from remove-from-game (scenario-only). Its own cross-cutting category like 'testless'. Consolidates dwl (Fire Extinguisher, Flare, Stroke of Luck), ptc (A Test of Will, Devil's Luck), ste (Cherished Keepsake, Leather Coat, A Test of Will).

'Remove from the game' as a self-effect/cost (gone for the scenario, NOT repurchasable; distinct from exile). Recurs across packs: dwl Lucky Dice / Gold Pocket Watch, ptc Quantum Flux / The Painted World / Seal of the Elder Sign / Cheat Death. Players filter for one-shot non-recurring cards via this.

Readying your own / another in-play asset or ally (refunding exhaust for re-use). The taxonomy had NO player-side ready tag (only EnemyDoesNotReady and the upkeep timing point). Split self vs other-asset vs ally because they map to different searches (weapon ready-on-success tempo vs ally support). Consolidates nat Galvanize, tdc Bulwark/Inspiring Presence/Luger, win Mauser/Beretta.

'This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity' / 'Engage actions do not provoke AoO'. Extremely common, distinctly searchable safety clause with no home. Optional 'action' arg distinguishes blanket protection (Trench Knife on engage) from a single ability's protection. Consolidates nat Mano a Mano, ptc (Lantern, Trench Knife, Mano a Mano, Archaic Glyphs), rt Dynamite Blast/Lantern, tde Followed.

An asset that absorbs damage/horror as an HP/sanity buffer (Composure suite, True Grit, Key of Ys, Cherished Keepsake). A foundational asset role with no tag. 'value' = printed soak amount (optional/omit when conditional). Core of the protector/tank archetype. Consolidates ptc SoakDamage/SoakHorror.

Taking harm meant for another investigator: resolving an enemy attack against you instead, taking another player's encounter card, or accepting damage/horror dealt to others at your location. Distinct from soak (absorbs your own) and cancel. The signature protector/guardian archetype. Consolidates ptc Heroic Rescue/'Let me handle this!'/True Grit, tsk Obsidian Bracelet/Girish, tfa Until the End of Time, par Heirloom (damage-assignment).

The Harvey Walters big-hand engine: increasing maximum hand size, and effects that scale with / are gated by the number of cards in hand. Only PhaseUpkeepCheckHandSize (a timing point) existed. Consolidates dwl Laboratory Assistant, har Vault of Knowledge/Arcane Enlightenment/Laboratory Assistant (increase) + Higher Education/Celaeno Fragments/Extensive Research/Farsight/Forbidden Tome (dependent).

Looking at the top N cards of a player deck or the encounter deck and optionally reordering them, WITHOUT pulling a specific card out (scry / divination / encounter-smoothing). DeckSearch implies extracting a target; this is non-search peek/reorder. Source flags it: '// look_at_encounter / order_encounter - Need tag type'. 'value' = count (-1 variable), 'reorder' = may reorder vs only look. Consolidates dwl Alyssa Graham, eote Parallel Fates/Astronomical Atlas, jac Parallel Fates.

Commit mechanics beyond the default (commit-from-hand-to-your-own-test is intentionally untagged). CommitOtherInvestigator = commit to someone else's test, possibly remote (Carson support). CommitFromNonHand = commit from deck-top/discard/attached (Norman Withers / fortune-teller engines). CommitFetch = dig and force-commit a skill (Daredevil/Copycat). CommitMax = 'Max N committed per skill test' (Guts family), flagged in source as '// max_1_commit - Need tag type'. Consolidates tsk, eote, win, jac, dwl(no).

A committed card GAINS extra skill icons (often [wild]), frequently scaling off a variable (charges spent, enemies engaged), or a support asset adds an icon to an already-committed card. Distinct from skill-value margin tags and from boost (which raise the investigator's value, not committed icons). Consolidates ptc Torrent of Power/'Not without a fight!', tcu Grisly Totem, tdc Confidence/Storm Ruler.

Cards that gate or scale on the investigator's own current self-state crossing a threshold: resources (big-money payoffs / 'while you have 10+ resources'), remaining sanity (low-sanity Survivor/Mystic payoffs), and cards in hand (overlaps but complements hand-size-dependent). 'comparison' = at-least/at-most, 'value' = threshold. NOTE: hand-size threshold also covered by HandSizeDependent; ConditionHandSize records the explicit numeric threshold cases. Consolidates ptc Anatomical Diagrams/Say Your Prayers/Dario, eote The Black Fan/Money Talks resource thresholds, tcu Steadfast/Cunning/Able Bodied threshold skills, har hand-size payoffs.

Acting at a location other than your own ('as if you were there'): investigating any revealed location, or moving to any revealed location (non-adjacent teleport-style travel). Distinct from location/move (connecting-location movement) and clue tags. Consolidates ptc In the Know (remote investigate) + Astral Travel/Cheat Death (remote move), tdc Spiritual Echo/Doppelganger. Remote-commit folded into commit/main CommitOtherInvestigator.

Reducing the DIFFICULTY (target number) of a skill test directly, rather than boosting your own skill value or reducing a location's shroud. Mechanically distinct from stats-mod boosts and LocationShroud. 'value' = amount (-1 dynamic). Consolidates etc Ruth Westmacott, tde Momentum.

newEnumMembersInExistingFiles.rationale: Put a card directly INTO play from hand, bypassing the normal play action/cost (Sleight of Hand, Joey 'The Rat', Archaic Glyphs, Library Docent). play-area only modeled leaving play (to-hand/to-deck); this is the inverse cheat-into-play. Consolidates dwl Joey, ptc Sleight of Hand, rt Archaic Glyphs, har Library Docent.
Tutor a card directly into play from your deck/discard (Flare, Randall Cho). DeckSearch covers the fetch; the into-play destination is the searchable novelty. Consolidates dwl Flare, nat Randall Cho.

Put a card (or a copy) directly into play from a discard pile (A Chance Encounter, Eidetic Memory). Distinct from discard-pile-to-hand. Consolidates dwl A Chance Encounter, ptc A Chance Encounter/Eidetic Memory.

Play a card (paying its cost) from a zone other than your own hand, or let another investigator play it: from your discard, deck-top, another player's hand, beneath/attached to a card, or set-aside. Distinct from into-play 'cheat' (which bypasses the play action) and from recursion (return-to-hand-first). Consolidates eote Untimely Transaction/Black Market/True Magick, tcu 'You owe me one!'/Twilight Blade/Dayana, har Farsight, tsk(no).

Play/resolve a card DIRECTLY from the discard pile (not first returned to hand). RecursionAsset/Event/Skill return to hand; DiscardPile* move to hand/deck; neither expresses playable-from-discard. A strong cross-pack graveyard-value archetype. Consolidates fhv (Pushed to the Limit, Eldritch Tongue, Persistence), tdc (Profane Idol, Improvised Weapon, A Glimmer of Hope), ptc, rt, nat, eote, tsk.

A card returns ITSELF to hand instead of being discarded (often gated on succeed-by), enabling repeated reuse. Existing recursion tags describe pulling OTHER cards. The signature Rogue reusable-event/skill engine. Consolidates win (Cheap Shot, Backstab, Pilfer, Slip Away, Opportunist), fhv, tfa self-replay.

Replay an event in place / resolve an ability an extra time ('Play that event again as if it were in your hand'). Distinct from RecursionEvent (returns from discard). Consolidates tcu Double Double/Dayana/Knowledge is Power.

Search your BONDED cards (set aside, out of play) for a specific card — the defining engine of the bonded archetype (Miss Doyle, Gate Box, Hallowed Mirror, Occult Lexicon). The existing DeckSearch range (deck/discard/encounter, top/bottom/all) cannot express the set-aside bonded zone. Added as a sibling member; the base 'range' field can be 'all'. Consolidates rt, tcu, tde.

Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand size (variable bulk draw). The DeckDraw base requires a fixed numeric 'value'; fill-to-cap is dynamic. Implement as a member whose 'value' is set to -1 (dynamic) per the base field. Consolidates tcu Glimpse the Unthinkable.

Proactively discard/thin the top of the ENCOUNTER deck (Split the Angle). DeckDiscardDeck/Self target the player deck; DeckSearchEncounter is look-at-top. A control archetype. Consolidates etc Split the Angle.

The ChaosSeal enum has 0/any/auto-fail/cultist/elder-sign/elder-thing/skull/tablet but NOT bless — despite bless being the namesake of the cycle. Multiple cards search the bag and seal bless (Codex of Ages, Radiant Smite, Holy Spear, Rite of Sanctification, Nephthys). Mirrors the reveal-side ChaosRevealTokenBless. Consolidates etc, par, tic.
Curse counterpart of ChaosSealTokenBless, also missing (Dark Ritual, Flute of the Outer Gods, Favor of the Moon). Consolidates par, tic.

Dynamically seal a token that was REVEALED during a skill test (permanently thinning the bag mid-test), distinct from the static Seal keyword that pre-specifies a token type at enter-play. Consolidates tdc Ocula Obscura/Dial of Ancients.

Resolve/release a pre-SEALED token in place of the random bag draw ('resolve a token sealed here instead'). Distinct from ChaosRevealAnotherInstead (reveal another random token) and ChaosRevealManual. The core of the sealed-token bag-control engine (Codex of Ages, Favor of the Sun/Moon, Tidal Memento, Flute of the Outer Gods). Consolidates etc, par, tic.

Generalizes the existing ChaosEffectTreatAsElderSign: convert a revealed token into a different token type for the test ('treat it as a [skull]/[bless]/[curse] instead'). 'to' = target type. Consolidates tic ('Lucky' Penny, Blessing of Isis, Curse of Aeons), fhv. (ChaosEffectTreatAsElderSign retained for the elder-sign case; new tag covers the others.)

Resolve a chaos-token-triggered effect an ADDITIONAL time (double it). The cancel half is covered by CancelChaos; effect-doubling has no tag. Consolidates jac Eldritch Inspiration, tcu Eldritch Inspiration.

Name/predict a token type, parity, or test margin, then get a payoff if a matching token was revealed (Crystal Pendulum, Prescient, Recall the Future, Foresight). A distinct fortune-teller archetype not expressible by any reveal/skill-value tag. New small file chaos/predict.ts.

A built-in conditional self-PENALTY (damage/horror/resource-loss) triggered by a bad chaos token during the card's own effect (NOT a cost paid to activate). Source flags it: '// Take horror when revealing chaos tokens - Need new tag type'. The classic risky-Mystic-spell drawback. damage/horror/resource variants. Consolidates jac (Azure Flame damage, Clairvoyance horror, Ineffable Truth resource, Astral Travel). New file chaos/downside.ts.
Horror variant of chaos self-downside (Clairvoyance).
Resource-loss variant of chaos self-downside (Ineffable Truth).

Forcibly disengage an enemy from investigators, or you disengage from each engaged enemy — the core of the evasion/escape package. enemy/engage only covered engage states. Source flags it: '// disengage - Need tag type' on Elusive/Cat Burglar. 'withoutExhaust' flags the Stealth variant (disengaged but kept ready). Consolidates par On the Lam, ptc Stealth/Snare Trap/Cheat Death, fhv Blackmail File, tde Gate Box/Ethereal Form.
'Attached enemy cannot attack' — a recurring lock-down (Rot attachments, handler cards). Sibling of the existing EnemyDoesNotReady/EnemyCannotMoveIntoLocation. Consolidates fhv Abyssal Rot.
'Attached enemy cannot move' — distinct from EnemyCannotMoveIntoLocation (about a location). Consolidates fhv Virescent Rot/Transmogrify.
'That enemy cannot engage you' — evasion-lock (Stealth). Sibling debuff. Consolidates ptc Stealth.
Force an enemy to exhaust (tempo/lockdown). Snare Trap, Mind Wipe-style. Consolidates ptc Snare Trap, tsk attach-lockdown cluster.

New printed use-token type 'offering' (Masks sub-theme), absent from the enum (ammo/charge/supply/secret/evidence). The base 'value' field carries the count. Consolidates fhv Wolf Mask/Speak to the Dead.
Printed 'Uses (N resources)' as a use-pool stored on the card, distinct from gaining resources to your pool. Consolidates fhv Bianca, jac Arcane Studies.

New printed use-token type 'inspiration' (tdc), absent from the enum. (Sibling future types 'shell'/'leads' may be added the same way if they recur.) Consolidates tdc Book of Verse/Artistic Inspiration.

Refilling a limited-use pool (charges/offerings/ammo/secrets), either automatically each round or on a trigger ('Replenish this charge the first time a bless token is revealed'). NO replenish tag existed despite the regex hint 'uses_replenish'. 'useType' = which pool, 'conditional' = triggered vs automatic. This is its own new file uses/replenish.ts. Consolidates fhv Ofuda/Masks/Wicked Athame/Call the Beyond, jac Arcane Studies.

A self-growing counter: place resources from the token pool onto THIS card as a renamed token (evidence/leads/offering) that starts empty and accrues via reactions, later spent. Distinct from UsesStarting (printed pool) and UsesSupport (place/move of an existing type). A signature TSK economy engine; also the resource-bank pattern (tcu Investments/Family Inheritance, relates to big-money). New file uses/accumulate.ts. Consolidates tsk Darrell's Kodak/Dissection Tools/Research Notes/Soul Sanctification, tcu Investments/Family Inheritance.

MOVE resources between investigators' pools (sharing/loan/trade), distinct from gaining new resources. Multiplayer big-money support. Note this is a no-value member, so it carries 'value' from the base = use -1/0 where the base requires it (implementer may relax the base 'value' to optional, OR place this in a new gain/transfer.ts file). Consolidates fhv 'I'll Pay You Back!'/Bank Job/Grift, dwl Teamwork (transfer asset/resource).
Parallel to the existing CostActionSpendResource and to CostFreeSpendSecret: an [action]-activated ability that spends a secret (Encyclopedia, Feed the Mind, Forbidden Tome). Consolidates har.

'Power at the price of doom': place doom on a card you control as an activation cost (Blood Pact, Abyssal Tome, Ceremonial Sickle/Dowsing Rod/Onyx Pentacle). Distinct from generic DoomAdd (to agenda). A deckbuilding hazard players filter on; also the self-doom mystic engine. Consolidates tic, tsk.
Ignore/cancel the 'lose actions' aspect of an incoming encounter/attack effect (Deny Existence). No cancel variant covered action-loss. Part of the modular aspect-ignore archetype. Consolidates tcu.
Ignore/cancel the 'lose resources' aspect of an incoming effect (Deny Existence). Consolidates tcu.
Ignore/cancel a forced hand-discard aspect of an incoming effect (Deny Existence). Completes the modular ignore set alongside the existing CancelDamage/CancelHorror. Consolidates tcu.

Discard/remove a treachery that is ALREADY in play (ongoing/attached), distinct from the existing on-draw cancels (CancelRevelation/CancelEncounterDraw/CancelEncounterEffect). Consolidates rt Alter Fate.

Cancel all effects/consequences of a (failed) skill test (Neither Rain nor Snow) — a Survivor fail-mitigation effect not covered by any cancel variant. Part of the fail-forward package. Consolidates ste.
Cancel/suppress a drawn weakness's effects (Ikiaq). Distinct from the encounter-card cancels; targets the player weakness mechanic. Consolidates tic.

An extra ATTACK within the resolution of a single card ('fight that enemy again' / 'fight again'), NOT a new game action — so not expressible by ActionAdditional (which grants a usable action). A burst-damage archetype. Placed in action/additional.ts as a sibling member. Consolidates nat One-Two Punch.

Resolve another card's [action]/[fast] ability without paying its cost (Hand-Eye Coordination, Dirty Deeds, Flurry of Blows; also resolving a Fight ability on a discarded/revealed weapon never deployed — Robert Castaigne). A major action-compression/combo enabler. NEW file action/activate.ts (a new enum TagTypeActionActivate). Consolidates fhv (Hand-Eye/Dirty Deeds/Flurry), tdc (Robert Castaigne/Remington), tcu (Knowledge is Power/Dayana).

Activate an asset's printed [action] ability while it is still IN YOUR HAND (discarding it instead of exhausting) — the Anchor Chain / Hand Hook / Nautical Charts cycle. Same new action/activate.ts file. Consolidates tdc.

End your turn as a drawback/tradeoff for a powerful effect (Ace in the Hole, Pay Day, Coup de Grace). Distinct from ActionLoseAction (losing a single action). Placed in the existing action/lose.ts. Consolidates dwl Ace in the Hole, tfa Pay Day/Coup de Grace.

Grant the FAST keyword to ANOTHER card you play (Daisy's Tote Bag, Directive, Chuck Fergus, Fence). cost/fast tags describe a card that IS fast; this grants fast to other cards — a tempo/action-compression enabler. Placed in the existing gain/keyword.ts (alongside Aloof/Retaliate). Consolidates par.

Redirect an attacking enemy's damage onto a DIFFERENT enemy ('Deal this attack's damage to a different enemy'). Distinct from DamageInsteadRange (your-attack-misses margin redirection). The 'turn attacks on enemies' control archetype. Consolidates dwl Oops!/Aquinnah, ste Oops!.

Assign/spread damage among MULTIPLE enemies at once (Flamethrower: 'assign up to 4 damage among enemies engaged with you'). Distinct from DamagePlus (flat bonus to one target). A group-clear archetype. 'value' = total spreadable (-1 for X). Consolidates tfa Flamethrower.
Adds the Tarot slot variant to the existing per-slot enum (Accessory/Ally/Arcane/Hand). Moon Pendant, Anna Kaslow. Consolidates rt, tcu.

Let one slot type substitute for another ('arcane slots can hold accessory-slot cards, and vice versa' — The Hierophant). Distinct from additive SlotAdditional. New file slot/convert.ts. Consolidates rt.

Raise the max health/sanity (durability) of your assets ('Each asset you control with health gets +1 health' — The Star). stats-mod tags cover skill values only; heal restores but does not raise max. New file buff/asset-stats.ts with health+sanity siblings. Consolidates rt The Star.
Sanity counterpart of BuffAssetHealth (The Star). Consolidates rt.

Skill value scales off the resources you HOLD (not spend): '+1 skill value for every 5 resources' / base value 'equal to half your resources'. Distinct from StatsModPumpResource (per resource SPENT) and from flat boosts. The big-money skill-scaling payoff. 'per' = denominator. New file skill-value/source.ts. Consolidates eote Money Talks, tcu Well Connected/Money Talks, rt Well Connected (flagged).

Effects that scale with the number of DIFFERENT classes among cards you control — the eote five-color/rainbow payoff (Gang Up, Strength in Numbers, Close the Circle, Cheat the System, Call for Backup, Join the Caravan). The unifying searchable hook for the whole multiclass sub-theme. 'reward' = what scales. New file multiclass/main.ts. Folds in GainResourceDynamicClassCount as reward='resource'. Consolidates eote.

Draw/reveal MORE encounter cards and choose which to resolve, discarding the rest — a soft-cancel / encounter-filter distinct from CancelEncounterDraw (full removal). New file encounter/main.ts. Consolidates tsk Dr. Maleson/Nature of the Beast, etc Dr. Maleson (adjacent).

Prevent the agenda from advancing when it reaches its doom threshold ('the agenda cannot advance by reaching its doom threshold') — a stall/buy-a-turn effect not covered by DoomAdd/Check/Remove. Placed in the existing doom/main.ts. Consolidates etc Mystifying Song, tcu Mystifying Song (flagged).

PLACE a clue (from the token bank) on a location, distinct from DISCOVERING a clue (ClueDiscover*) and from ClueAdditional (extra clues during an investigation). Placing seeds a clue to be collected / fuels 'when a clue is placed' tech. New file clue/place.ts. Consolidates etc Mysteries Remain.

The 'after you fail a skill test' reaction/play window — the defining Survivor fail-forward trigger. Distinct from SkillTestConditionFail (a result-gate) and from existing timing/after triggers. Placed in timing/after.ts. Consolidates ste Rabbit's Foot/Grit Your Teeth/Live and Learn/Take Heart.
'After you engage an enemy' trigger (Zoey's Cross), the search hook for engage-synergy builds. Consistent with existing selective timing-after triggers. Consolidates par.

Re-attempt/repeat a failed skill test ('Attempt that test again') — a distinct second-chance effect not in initiate.ts (new test) or skill-value/result (margins). New file test/repeat.ts. Part of fail-forward. Consolidates ste Live and Learn.

argumentAdditions.rationale: Many cards grant an additional action to ANOTHER chosen investigator (Guidance, Lifeline, End of the Road), not just yourself. ActionAdditional already models extra-action grants (the dwl/fhv 'gain N actions' and deferred 'next turn' cases also fold in here via its 'value' field); adding an optional 'target' lets the existing tag distinguish self vs chosen-investigator grants. Confirms ActionAdditionalGain (dwl), ActionExtraNextTurn (fhv), and the tsk extra-action cluster are NOT new tags.

Several extra-slot cards lock the slot to a trait ('2 additional hand slots, only for Tome assets' — Daisy's Tote Bag; 'ally slots only for Creature assets' — Rod of Animalism; Bandolier weapon-only). Per the rubric, the broad searchable thing is the extra slot; the trait is an optional filter. Add 'restrictedToTrait?' to the SlotAdditional base rather than minting per-trait variants. Confirms SlotAdditionalCreatureAlly (eote) is NOT a new tag.

Some resource gains are a DYNAMIC amount rather than a fixed 'value' ('gain resources equal to that enemy's printed health' — Jenny's Twin .45s; 'gain 1 per different class' — Cheat the System; 'twice that many' — Watch this!). The searchable thing ('gain resources') is already the tag; only the dynamic source is new. Add an optional 'dynamic' flag (and let 'value' be -1) on the GainResource base rather than minting GainResourceDynamicClassCount. The class-count payoff is also captured by MulticlassClassCount reward='resource'.

'Treat the modifier of each [curse] token as 0' / 'as +1' (Accursed, Dawn Star, Skeptic, Blasphemous Covenant). This is a specific modifier-override that sits between the existing ChaosEffectModifier and ChaosEffectIgnoreModifier; an optional 'treatAs' numeric on ChaosEffectModifier captures it without a near-duplicate tag. Confirms ChaosEffectTreatModifierAsZero (fhv) is NOT a separate tag.

newCompoundTags.name: chaos-token-control
newCompoundTags.rationale: The flagship cross-pack archetype the rubric explicitly names (reveal-more / ignore / cancel / seal / check-what-is-revealed / treat-as / predict). Proposed independently by 7 packs (etc, jac, rt, tcu, tdc, tfa, tic). Groups the granular chaos reveal/effect/seal/predict primitives plus cancel-chaos into one searchable 'bag tech' package, regardless of bless/curse flavor.

newCompoundTags.name: bless-curse-bag
newCompoundTags.rationale: The bless/curse token-economy build-around: adding, removing/returning, replacing, sealing, and reacting to bless/curse tokens. Proposed by fhv, par, tic. Distinct from generic chaos-token-control (which is bless/curse-agnostic). Players building a Blessed or Cursed deck search this whole subsystem as one unit.

newCompoundTags.name: big-money
newCompoundTags.rationale: The recurring 'big money' resource-economy archetype the rubric calls out: generate/move/bank resources, scale skill value off a high pool, and pay off resource thresholds. Proposed by eote, fhv, nat, ptc, rt, tcu, tfa. Groups the resource generation/movement/banking tags with the resource-as-skill and resource-threshold payoffs.

newCompoundTags.name: evasion-package
newCompoundTags.rationale: The evasion/escape toolkit players deckbuild as one unit: auto/testless evade, forced disengage, cannot-engage debuff, enemy exhaust, evade reduction, no-AoO maneuvering, and self-relocation to break melee. Proposed by par, ptc, rt. Existing AutoEvade/TestlessEvade are joined by the new disengage/debuff/aoo tags.

newCompoundTags.name: protector-tank
newCompoundTags.rationale: The Guardian/defender 'take the hit for the team' package: soak damage/horror, redirect attacks/encounter cards/damage onto yourself. Proposed by ptc; reinforced by tsk/tfa redirect cards. Groups the new soak and tank tags.

newCompoundTags.name: fail-forward
newCompoundTags.rationale: The Survivor 'benefit when you fail a skill test' identity: trigger off, reward, mitigate, or re-attempt a failed test. Proposed by ste. Broader than the existing fail-by compound (margins only); adds the fail-timing trigger, re-test, and cancel-fail-effects.

newCompoundTags.name: exile-package
newCompoundTags.rationale: The exile (one powerful use, then removed from collection / repurchase with XP) deckbuilding sub-theme. Introduced in dwl and recurring (ptc, ste). A deckbuilder finds all 'one-shot, then gone' cards via this. (Campaign XP-repurchase support such as ste Deja Vu is rejected as a standalone tag but conceptually anchors here.)

newCompoundTags.name: into-play-cheat
newCompoundTags.rationale: Putting cards directly into play from hand/deck/discard (bypassing the play action / sometimes cost), or playing from a non-hand zone. A tempo/recursion enabler family. Proposed by dwl, eote, nat, ptc, rt. Groups the new play-area into-play members.

newCompoundTags.name: discard-pile-value
newCompoundTags.rationale: The graveyard/flashback value archetype: play directly from discard, return cards (or themselves) from discard, replay events. Proposed by fhv, tdc, win. Groups existing and new recursion/discard-pile tags.

newCompoundTags.name: deck-top-control
newCompoundTags.rationale: The divination/foresight 'control what you draw' archetype: scry player/encounter decks, commit from deck-top, choose among revealed encounter cards, predict draws. Proposed by dwl, eote, jac. Mirrors the existing clue-tech compound.

newCompoundTags.name: action-compression
newCompoundTags.rationale: The tempo/combo 'do more per action' archetype: resolve abilities without paying their cost, activate from hand, gain extra actions/attacks, ready assets to act again. Proposed by fhv, nat, tdc, tde, tsk. Groups the new activate/ready tags with ActionAdditional.

newCompoundTags.name: multiclass-payoff
newCompoundTags.rationale: The eote five-color/rainbow build-around: cards rewarding many different classes among cards you control. A single-pack-anchored but distinctive archetype worth naming for future packs. Proposed by eote.

rejected.proposal: ActionAdditionalGain (grant N extra actions this turn) as a new tag
rejected.reason: Covered by existing TagActionAdditional via its optional 'value' field; confirmed by eote/tcu/tdc/tsk coverage notes. Added a 'target' arg instead (see argumentAdditions).

rejected.proposal: ActionExtraNextTurn (extra actions on a future turn)
rejected.reason: Folds into TagActionAdditional (Bide Your Time is still 'gain additional actions'); the deferred-turn nuance is too thin to mint a tag.
Redundant with existing TagAttachEnemy (the generic attach-to-enemy is the searchable unit); the pack author flagged it for dropping.

rejected.proposal: BondedSwap (swap a card with its bonded partner moving tokens)
rejected.reason: Niche transform mechanic on a handful of bespoke cards; the bonded archetype is already served by DeckSearchBonded. Below the cross-pack threshold.
Equivalent to / folded into an optional 'treatAs' arg on the existing ChaosEffectModifier (see argumentAdditions); not a distinct tag.

rejected.proposal: ChaosRevealReturnAndRedraw (cancel a revealed token, return it, reveal new)
rejected.reason: Adequately expressed by CancelChaos + ChaosRevealAnotherInstead (verified in tdc/tsk notes for Uncanny Specimen/Custom Modifications); no new tag needed.
Folded into MulticlassClassCount (reward='resource') and the GainResource 'dynamic' arg; the resource gain itself is already the searchable tag.

rejected.proposal: GainResourceBank as its own gain tag
rejected.reason: Modeled as UsesAccumulate (place renamed tokens on a card, later spend) — the same banking mechanic; avoids a near-duplicate. Grouped under big-money.

rejected.proposal: UsesRechargeAsset (add charges to an in-play asset)
rejected.reason: Expressible via the existing UsesSupport* tags (supportType:'place') which already model placing charges/secrets onto another asset (verified in tdc/ptc notes).
Consolidated into a single ChaosPredict tag; the prediction kind is a low-value filter, not separate searches.
Kept the concept but placed it under chaos/downside.ts (ChaosDownsideDamage/Horror/Resource) since every instance is a chaos-token-triggered penalty; a generic 'downside' category would be too broad.

rejected.proposal: CommitMaxPerTest in a separate 'commit' restriction tag set
rejected.reason: Kept the concept as CommitMax in the consolidated commit/main.ts rather than a standalone file.

Requires adding 'engage' to kohaku's BasicAction enum (confirmed it currently lacks it: fight/investigate/evade/move/parley/resign/play/draw/resource). Out of scope for this taxonomy delta; the additional-action itself is already tagged.

rejected.proposal: CostAddChaosTokenToPlay as a separate cost tag
rejected.reason: Modeled as ChaosBagAddCurse/AddBless (the 'additional cost: add tokens' is the same bag-manipulation effect); avoids splitting one mechanic across cost/ and chaos/.
Implemented instead as CancelWeaknessDraw under the existing cancel/main.ts to sit with the other cancel variants.
Single-card (Impromptu Barrier); below threshold and adequately surfaced via the evasion package. No archetype yet.

rejected.proposal: RecursionSelfFromDiscard with shuffleBack arg as distinct from RecursionSelfToHand
rejected.reason: Consolidated: play-from-discard is RecursionPlayFromDiscard; return-to-hand is RecursionSelfToHand. The shuffle-back rider is obvious-from-text.
Very rare (Memories of Another Life, Transfiguration); a campaign/deckbuilding edge case below the cross-pack threshold. Can be a future DeckSearch member if it recurs.
Folded into ActionActivateIgnoringCost (resolving an ability on a card without paying its cost) — Robert Castaigne/Remington are the same 'free activation' mechanic.

rejected.proposal: New use-token types 'shell' and 'leads' as enum members now
rejected.reason: Deferred: each appears on ~1 card (Mauser Tankgewehr / On Their Heels). Add to uses/starting.ts only if they recur; 'inspiration' is added now as it appears on multiple cards.

A between-scenario XP/campaign-log effect, not an in-play game effect; the taxonomy intentionally omits campaign-layer mechanics (cf. Green Man Medallion, Charon's Obol, Arcane Research). Conceptually supports exile-package but not tagged.

rejected.proposal: Granny Orne / Quick Learner bidirectional skill-value & difficulty modifiers
rejected.reason: ~2 cards with a niche +1/-1 knob that doesn't fit boost (named +X) cleanly; below threshold pending more examples.
Adequately expressed by existing DoomAdd + DoomRemove plus the new CostAddDoomSelf; a dedicated compound for one pack's self-doom engine is premature.
Kept the concept but placed under the consolidated commit/main.ts as CommitOtherInvestigator (with range arg).
Single-card; 'treat enemy text box as blank' has no cross-pack support. Below threshold.

rejected.proposal: Sharpshooter 'use enemy evade instead of fight value' enemy-stat substitution
rejected.reason: Single-card; partially expressible via EnemyValueEvade/Fight presence. Below threshold for a dedicated substitution tag.
